penalties_applied.name: requires_human_fulfillment
penalties_applied.reason: Solving context-window-driven code duplication requires deep codebase analysis and tooling that integrates into dev workflows (IDE plugins, CI hooks). Setup and onboarding per team is non-trivial and likely needs human-guided configuration.

penalties_applied.name: high_touch_support
penalties_applied.reason: Developer tools with codebase-specific behavior generate high support load — edge cases per language/framework require human-judgement responses.

rationale: The target buyer is clear — software developers and engineering teams already paying $19-20/month for AI coding tools — and the pain is real and frequent. However, the core fix (pre-AI context management, deduplication enforcement, codebase indexing) requires building a non-trivial developer tool that integrates into existing IDEs or CI pipelines, well beyond what Claude prompts + a landing page can ship. Operational autonomy is low because the tool's value is deeply tied to each team's specific codebase, making per-customer setup unavoidable. The total after penalties drops to 3.5 — below the validate threshold.
solution_plan: This opportunity is not viable for a solo non-technical operator using this factory. The product would need to be an IDE extension or a CLI tool that indexes codebases, detects duplicate logic, and feeds structured context summaries to AI assistants before they write code — requiring real software engineering to build, maintain, and integrate with Cursor/Copilot APIs. There is no version of this that the factory can ship as a Claude prompt plus a Stripe link and a form. Recommend drop.
notes: Fails operational_autonomy_min (4 < 7) and buildability_with_ai_min (4 < 6). Even if total were higher, both build gates would block promotion.
